role: AxisAlignedBB by value, header only: struct aabb and the aabb_* functions as static inline (construction, addCoord, expand, the offset forms, intersectsWith and the three calculateX/Y/ZOffset clipping rules that Entity.moveEntity uses).

structs.name: aabb
structs.java: AxisAlignedBB (minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ)

notes: Pure value functions, no state, no allocation: GPU-ready as written. The calculate*Offset functions take the list box first and the entity box second, mirroring Java's receiver/argument order. Inline since lane/mobtick (aabb.c removed): the same operations in the same order, built with -ffp-contract=off. Not ported here: setBounds, func_111270_a (union), contract, isVecInside, getAverageEdgeLength, calculateIntercept, setBB; callers that need them inline the math elsewhere.
